notes: Fixed entity IDs and one warmed world across all rounds. Purchases include submission, evaluation, and ordinary outcome materialization; read operations count returned components.

Three alternating before/after process repetitions, ten rounds/process for purchase/read comparisons. Counters and wall time use separate processes. Identical workspace features and per-thread CPU pinning.

Baseline source hashes come from the initial baseline manifest. Candidate hashes come from their own measurement manifests. The allocating probe was corrected after the baseline to exclude Tokio yield scheduling from user-kernel attribution; that probe is excluded from all before/after comparisons. Purchase/read fixture code was unchanged.
Inline experiment removed more calls but increased future-frame/allocation bytes. Compact Vec of erased cell guards is retained.
Busy workstation; timing differences of a few percent are not evidence of a stable speedup. Scheduling interleavings can alter engine allocation counts, especially with one worker.
Raw TSV and reports remain under target/steady-allocations; this tracked file retains summaries, original source provenance, and report hashes.
